svg.text: Front posts (2) 766 mm and rear posts (2) 696 mm long on their

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line; cut the top end at 10 degrees, sloping down to the back.

svg.text: Base plate 50 x 100 x 8 mm, the post centred on it 25 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the outer end; two 11 mm holes on its centre line, 15 and 85 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the outer end (235 and 165 mm from the cabinet centre).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rail bolts, 40 mm apart along the slope.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld both plates all round; paint.

svg.text: through plate, roof and beam, nuts under the beam.
